name: Livestock Science Camp
org: NC State College of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Animal Science
what_you_do: A week of hands-on work with cattle, sheep, goats, horses and pigs. You also do lab tests on food, genes and biotech, and learn about jobs with animals.
deadline_text: The camp page says the camp is cancelled, as of Nov 3, 2026. It was listed for June 14-19, 2026. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: You cannot apply now. The camp page says to watch for future programs. Questions: Dr. Carrie Pickworth, 919-513-0262.
notes: The page has a CANCELLED banner with no year. Its intro says ages 15 to 18, but its apply section says 15 to 17.
